*.name: Display name for this power (optional; overrides the default).
*.hidden: If true, this power is not listed on the origin screen.
*.condition: Only applies while this condition passes (a DSL condition object — use pick).

neoorigins:action_on_event.entity_action: EntityAction run on the player as a side-effect when the configured event fires.
neoorigins:action_on_event.modifier: FloatModifier (or array) chained onto the event's value (e.g. exhaustion, regen).
neoorigins:action_on_event.block_condition: Block-position filter for block events (block_break, block_place, block_use). Ignored on other events.
neoorigins:action_on_event.effect: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for this exact mob-effect id (e.g. 'spore:mycelium_ef'). Ignored on other events.
neoorigins:action_on_event.effect_tag: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for effects in this tag (e.g. '#minecraft:harmful'). Combine with 'effect' (OR-matched). Ignored on other events.
neoorigins:action_on_event.immunity_ticks: EFFECT_APPLIED only: after a successful cleanse (action cancels the event), grant this many ticks of full immunity to the same effect id before re-rolling. 20 = 1s; default 0 (no grace).

neoorigins:action_on_hit.action: Effect on dealing damage: restore_health, restore_hunger, grant_effect, or target_effect.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.amount: Half-hearts healed (restore_health) or food points fed (restore_hunger); default 2.0.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.amplifier: Potion amplifier for grant_effect/target_effect (0 = level I); default 0.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.chance: Probability 0.0-1.0 the action triggers per qualifying hit; default 1.0.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.damage_type: Optional damage-type id filter; the action only fires for matching sources.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.duration: Effect duration in ticks for grant/target_effect (20 = 1s); default 100.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.effect: Mob effect id applied to self (grant_effect) or the victim (target_effect).
neoorigins:action_on_hit.min_damage: Minimum incoming damage required before the action triggers; default 0.0.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.target_group: Optional entity-group filter (undead, arthropod, ...) restricting which victims trigger it.
neoorigins:action_on_hit.target_type: Optional specific entity-type id filter for the victim.

neoorigins:active_ability.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between uses in ticks (20 = 1s); default 60.
neoorigins:active_ability.entity_action: EntityAction tree executed on the player when the keybind fires.
neoorigins:active_ability.hunger_cost: Food/exhaustion points consumed per successful activation; default 0.
neoorigins:active_ability.key: Active keybind slot that triggers the ability.

neoorigins:active_bolt.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between casts in ticks (20 = 1s); default 80.
neoorigins:active_bolt.speed: Velocity of the launched wind charge along the look direction; default 1.2.

neoorigins:active_dash.allow_vertical: If true the dash follows look pitch; if false it stays horizontal; default false.
neoorigins:active_dash.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between dashes in ticks (20 = 1s); default 40.
neoorigins:active_dash.power: Magnitude of the dash velocity vector; default 1.5.
neoorigins:active_dash.set_velocity: If true replace the player's velocity; if false add to it; default false.

neoorigins:active_fireball.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between casts in ticks (20 = 1s); default 100.
neoorigins:active_fireball.speed: Velocity applied to each of the spread small fireballs; default 1.5.

neoorigins:active_phase.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between phases in ticks (20 = 1s); default 40.
neoorigins:active_phase.hunger_cost: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful phase; default 0.
neoorigins:active_phase.max_depth: Maximum wall thickness in blocks the phase can pass through; default 16.

neoorigins:active_place_block.block_id: Block id placed at the targeted face; default minecraft:glowstone.
neoorigins:active_place_block.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between placements in ticks (20 = 1s); default 100.
neoorigins:active_place_block.hunger_cost: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful placement; default 0.
neoorigins:active_place_block.max_distance: Maximum ray-pick reach in blocks for the placement surface; default 5.0.

neoorigins:active_recall.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown in ticks (20 = 1s) between recalls to bed/spawn; default 600.

neoorigins:active_swap.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between swaps in ticks (20 = 1s); default 80.
neoorigins:active_swap.range: Max distance in blocks to find the looked-at entity to swap with; default 20.0.

neoorigins:active_teleport.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between teleports in ticks (20 = 1s); default 60.
neoorigins:active_teleport.hunger_cost: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful teleport; default 0.
neoorigins:active_teleport.mode: "target" teleports to the looked-at spot, "random" to a nearby safe spot; default target.
neoorigins:active_teleport.range: Maximum teleport distance in blocks; default 32.0.

neoorigins:attribute_modifier.amount: Numeric value applied to the attribute under the chosen operation; required.
neoorigins:attribute_modifier.attribute: Attribute id to modify, e.g. minecraft:generic.movement_speed or minecraft:block_interaction_range / entity_interaction_range for reach; required.
neoorigins:attribute_modifier.equipment_condition: Optional gate matching a worn item by id/tag in a slot; active only while worn.
neoorigins:attribute_modifier.location_condition: Optional gate on dimension/biome/structure; active only while there.
neoorigins:attribute_modifier.operation: How amount applies: add_value, add_multiplied_base, or add_multiplied_total.

neoorigins:bare_hand_tool.tool: Vanilla tool item id the empty hand emulates for tier/break speed; default stone_pickaxe.

neoorigins:break_speed_modifier.multiplier: Mining-speed multiplier; stacks multiplicatively with other instances; default 2.0.

neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.drain_rate: (legacy) Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; higher = slower (20 = 1s, default).
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.drain_interval_ticks: Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; clearer alias of drain_rate. Higher = slower drain (20 = 1s).
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.air_loss_per_second: Air points lost per second while submerged. Higher = faster drain. Overrides drain_interval_ticks / drain_rate when set.
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.fluid: Fluid that suffocates the player, "water" or "lava"; default water.

neoorigins:breath_out_of_fluid.drain_rate: Ticks between each air drain while out of the fluid (20 = 1s).
neoorigins:breath_out_of_fluid.fluid: Fluid the player must stay in to breathe; drying on land drains air.

neoorigins:burn.burn_duration: Ticks of fire set on the player each application (20 = 1s; default 100).
neoorigins:burn.interval: Ticks between each fire application; <=0 disables (default 20).

neoorigins:command_pack.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before this ability can be triggered again (default 40).
neoorigins:command_pack.range: Max block distance of the look-targeted entity your tamed mobs attack (default 32).

neoorigins:condition_passive.entity_action: EntityAction run on the player each interval when the condition passes.
neoorigins:condition_passive.interval_ticks: Ticks between condition checks (20 = 1s); same as interval.

neoorigins:mob_behavior.aggression: neutral = vanilla AI unchanged (only retaliate applies); hostile = always target the target type on sight; conditional = target a player only while every hostile_when condition holds. Default neutral.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.hostile_when: List of conditions (AND-ed) tested against the PROSPECTIVE PLAYER TARGET (piglin-style, e.g. 'player not wearing gold'), not the mob. Only used when aggression = conditional; empty list behaves like hostile.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.retaliate: Also fight back against whatever damaged the mob (vanilla hurt-by-target). Default true.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.anger_linger_ticks: Keep the target this many ticks after the trigger stops holding, so the mob calms down gradually instead of instantly (default 200 = 10s).
neoorigins:mob_behavior.aggro_range: Max distance to acquire a target (default 16.0).
neoorigins:mob_behavior.target_type: Entity type id to be hostile toward; omitted = players. Conditions only apply to player targets.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.call_for_help: When retaliating, alert nearby same-type mobs (vanilla pack aggro). Default false.

neoorigins:conditional.inner_power: Resource id of another power that is only active while this condition holds.

neoorigins:craft_amount_bonus.bonus_count: Extra copies of the output added per craft (default 4; skipped if <=0).
neoorigins:craft_amount_bonus.output_item: Item id whose crafting triggers the bonus (default oak_planks).

neoorigins:crop_growth_accelerator.growths_per_interval: Number of random nearby crops bone-mealed each interval (default 1).
neoorigins:crop_growth_accelerator.radius: Cubic block radius around the player scanned for crops (default 4).

neoorigins:crop_harvest_bonus.extra_drops: Extra copies of the block's own loot when breaking crops/logs (default 1).

neoorigins:dodge_chance.chance: Probability 0.0-1.0 to fully cancel an incoming damage event (default 0.15).

neoorigins:edible_item.always_edible: If true the item can be eaten even at full hunger (default true).
neoorigins:edible_item.fast: If true the item is consumed with the quick eat animation.
neoorigins:edible_item.item_condition: Optional condition an item must match (in addition to items/tags) to be edible.
neoorigins:edible_item.items: List of item ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).
neoorigins:edible_item.meat: If true the food counts as meat for diet/wolf interactions.
neoorigins:edible_item.tags: List of item-tag ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).

neoorigins:effect_immunity.effects: List of mob-effect ids whose application to the player is cancelled.

neoorigins:elytra_boost.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the boost can be triggered again (default 40).
neoorigins:elytra_boost.strength: Multiplier on the forward impulse applied while elytra gliding (default 1.5).

neoorigins:enhanced_vision.exposure: Brightness 0-1 in darkness; client currently uses ~0.7 (default 0.7).

neoorigins:entity_group.group: Mob classification: undead, arthropod, water, or undefined (changes effect/enchant interactions).

neoorigins:exhaustion_filter.sources: Exhaustion sources to suppress, e.g. sprint, mining (default [sprint]).

neoorigins:extra_inventory.drop_on_death: If true the extra inventory drops on death instead of persisting (default false).
neoorigins:extra_inventory.size: Slot count, rounded to a multiple of 9 (min 9, max 54; default 9).

neoorigins:fortune_when_effect.effect: Mob effect that must be active on the player for the Fortune bonus.
neoorigins:fortune_when_effect.level: Virtual Fortune level rolled via the vanilla ore-drops formula.
neoorigins:fortune_when_effect.target: Block tag the bonus applies to (default #c:ores; ancient debris excluded).

neoorigins:ground_slam.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the slam can be reused (default 120 = 6s).
neoorigins:ground_slam.damage: Damage dealt to each entity caught in the slam (default 6.0).
neoorigins:ground_slam.knockback_strength: Outward knockback pushing hit entities away (default 1.5).
neoorigins:ground_slam.radius: Blocks around the player whose entities are hit (default 6.0).

neoorigins:hide_hud_bar.bar: Which HUD bar to hide: hunger/food or air/oxygen/breath (default hunger).

neoorigins:horde_regen.combat_cooldown_ticks: Ticks a tamed mob must avoid damage before it can heal (default 100).
neoorigins:horde_regen.heal_amount: Health restored to each eligible tamed mob per interval (default 1.0).

neoorigins:invulnerability.damage_tags: Damage-type tag ids (e.g. minecraft:is_fire) whose damage is cancelled.
neoorigins:invulnerability.damage_types: Damage-type ids (e.g. minecraft:fall) whose damage is cancelled.
neoorigins:invulnerability.msg_ids: Vanilla damage msgId strings (e.g. inFire, fall) whose damage is cancelled.

neoorigins:item_magnetism.radius: Blocks around the player within which dropped items are pulled in (default 4.0).

neoorigins:js_active.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between uses in ticks (20 = 1s), consumed only when the JS onUse returns true; default 20.
neoorigins:js_active.hunger_cost: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful activation (JS onUse returns true); default 0.

neoorigins:keep_inventory.items: Item ids to keep on death; empty (with empty tags) keeps everything.
neoorigins:keep_inventory.slots: Slot categories kept: hotbar, main, armor, offhand, or * for all (default *).
neoorigins:keep_inventory.tags: Item tag ids whose matching items are kept on death.

neoorigins:lava_vision.strength: Lava fog distance multiplier; higher sees farther in lava (default 3.0).

neoorigins:less_item_use_slowdown.item_type: Item being used that gets reduced slowdown: any, bow, shield, or an id substring.
neoorigins:less_item_use_slowdown.speed_multiplier: Movement-speed bonus while using the item, as a fraction of base (default 0.5).

neoorigins:light_level_effect.ambient: Whether the applied effect is ambient (fainter particles; default true).
neoorigins:light_level_effect.effect: Mob effect id applied at/below the light threshold (required).
neoorigins:light_level_effect.max_light_level: Highest light level at which the effect still applies (default 4).
neoorigins:light_level_effect.show_icon: Whether the effect's HUD icon is shown (default false).
neoorigins:light_level_effect.show_particles: Whether the effect's ambient particles are shown (default false).

neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.active: Optional display-only translation key advertising which keybind slot the power expects (e.g. 'key.use_skill_1'). Actual dispatch is via the skill-slot system.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.bonus_rolls: Extra rolls added to `rolls` per activation; default 0. Mirrors vanilla loot-pool naming.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.cooldown: Cooldown in ticks between activations (20 = 1s); default 0.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.grant_id: Unique id tracked so the bundle is granted only once per player. Dedups the whole pool, not individual rolled stacks. Shares the starting_equipment grant attachment so a /origin reset clears both.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.loot_table: ResourceLocation of the vanilla loot table to roll on activation (e.g. 'neoorigins:rewards/wood_starter'). Reuses the full vanilla loot infrastructure (weighted entries, conditions, functions, modifiers).
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.rolls: Number of times the table is rolled per activation; default 1. Combined with bonus_rolls; if both are zero the harness lints the power as a no-op.

neoorigins:low_hp_threshold.effects: List of {effect, amplifier} entries applied while below the threshold.
neoorigins:low_hp_threshold.threshold: Health fraction below which the effects activate (0.5 = 50%; default 0.5).

neoorigins:mobs_ignore_player.entity_types: Entity ids or #tags of mobs that never aggro or target this player. Empty/omitted = matches every mob.
neoorigins:mobs_ignore_player.passive: When true, the ignore is unconditional — even hitting the mob does not provoke retaliation. Default false (the mob may target back briefly after being hit).

neoorigins:model_color.alpha: Player model tint opacity, 0.0 transparent to 1.0 opaque (default 1.0).
neoorigins:model_color.blue: Blue channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).
neoorigins:model_color.green: Green channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).
neoorigins:model_color.red: Red channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).

neoorigins:modify_damage.direction: "in" scales damage taken, "out" scales damage dealt (default in).
neoorigins:modify_damage.multiplier: Factor applied to the damage; 0.5 halves, 2.0 doubles (default 1.0).
neoorigins:modify_damage.target_group: Optional entity-group filter limiting which targets/attackers apply.

neoorigins:modify_food_nutrition.food_item: Optional item id; only this food's nutrition is overridden.
neoorigins:modify_food_nutrition.food_tag: Optional item tag; only matching foods are overridden.
neoorigins:modify_food_nutrition.nutrition: Hunger points matching food gives, saturation scaled with it (default 1).

neoorigins:modify_lava_speed.operation: How value combines with the vanilla lava factor: addition, multiply_base, multiply_total.
neoorigins:modify_lava_speed.value: Amount applied to lava movement speed (addition ~0.4 ≈ walking pace in lava).

neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.bed_override: If true also overrides the player's bed/anchor spawn, not just respawns.
neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.biome: Biome the resolved respawn location must be in.
neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.dimension: Dimension the player respawns into when spawn is overridden.
neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.spawn_strategy: How the respawn position is chosen within the dimension/biome.

neoorigins:no_mob_spawns_nearby.categories: Mob groups blocked: monster, creature, ambient, water_creature, or all (default monster).
neoorigins:no_mob_spawns_nearby.radius: Block radius around the player where natural spawning is suppressed (default 24). Vanilla already blocks MONSTER-category natural spawns within 24 blocks of any player, so use a value above 24 to extend the safe zone meaningfully.

neoorigins:no_slowdown.block_tag: Block tag to limit slowdown immunity to; omit for immunity to all slowdown.

neoorigins:overlay.texture: Resource location of the full-screen texture rendered over the view.

neoorigins:particle.frequency: Emit every N ticks (20 = 1s; default 8, min 1).
neoorigins:particle.offset: [x,y,z] offset in blocks from the player to spawn at (default [0,1,0]).
neoorigins:particle.particle: Particle id, or object form like {type:minecraft:dust,color,scale}.
neoorigins:particle.speed: Particle motion speed passed to the spawn call (default 0.0 = still).

neoorigins:persistent_effect.ambient: If true the effect is ambient (fainter HUD swirl; default true).
neoorigins:persistent_effect.duration: Refresh duration in ticks (20 = 1s); reapplied while active.
neoorigins:persistent_effect.effect: Status effect id to apply for a single-effect entry.
neoorigins:persistent_effect.effects: List of effect entries (effect, amplifier, ambient, show_particles, show_icon).
neoorigins:persistent_effect.show_icon: If true the effect icon shows in the HUD (default true).
neoorigins:persistent_effect.show_particles: If true the effect emits ambient particles (default false).

neoorigins:phantom_form.invisibility: If true the player gains Invisibility while in phantom form (default true).
neoorigins:phantom_form.no_gravity: If true gravity is disabled so the player can free-fly (default true).

neoorigins:prevent_action.action: Action blocked: fall_damage, fire, drown, freeze, sprint_food, armor_equip, swim, sleep, elytra...
neoorigins:prevent_action.active_when: When it applies: always, sneaking, not_sneaking, on_ground, not_on_ground.

neoorigins:prevent_death.action: Entity action run on the player each time a lethal hit is prevented.
neoorigins:prevent_death.cooldown_ticks: Ticks the power goes inert after a save (20 = 1s; default 0).
neoorigins:prevent_death.damage_types: Comma-separated damage-type filter; only matching killing blows are prevented.
neoorigins:prevent_death.invert: If true treat damage_types as a blacklist (prevent all except those).
neoorigins:prevent_death.set_health: Health the player is left at after a save (default 1.0, min 1).

neoorigins:projectile_immunity.chance: Probability 0.0-1.0 an incoming matching projectile is negated (default 1.0).
neoorigins:projectile_immunity.projectile_types: Projectiles blocked: arrow, fireball, trident, all, or an entity id (default arrow).
neoorigins:projectile_immunity.teleport: If true a successful dodge triggers a short random teleport (default false).
neoorigins:projectile_immunity.teleport_range: Max teleport distance in blocks on a dodge when enabled (default 16).

neoorigins:quality_equipment.bonus_armor_toughness: Flat armor toughness added to crafted/smithed armor (default 1.0).
neoorigins:quality_equipment.bonus_attack_damage: Fraction of base attack damage added to crafted weapons (default 0.20).
neoorigins:quality_equipment.bonus_mining_speed: Fraction of base mining speed added to crafted tools (default 0.25).
neoorigins:quality_equipment.durability_multiplier: Fraction of base durability added to crafted items (default 0.10).

neoorigins:rare_wandering_loot.master_slots: Random master-tier villager trades added to wandering traders (default 3).
neoorigins:rare_wandering_loot.treasure_chance: Probability 0.0-1.0 a rare treasure trade is also offered (default 0.25).

neoorigins:resource.color: Hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for the HUD resource bar fill.
neoorigins:resource.label: Display name shown on the HUD resource bar (e.g. "Mana").
neoorigins:resource.max: Maximum value the resource can hold (default 100).
neoorigins:resource.max_action: EntityAction run once when the resource rises to its max.
neoorigins:resource.min: Minimum value the resource can drop to (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.min_action: EntityAction run once when the resource falls to its min.
neoorigins:resource.regen_condition: EntityCondition that must pass for regen to apply (default always).
neoorigins:resource.regen_interval: Ticks between regen ticks (20 = 1s; default 20, min 1).
neoorigins:resource.regen_rate: Amount added each regen interval; 0 disables regen (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.start_value: Value the resource starts at when first granted (default max).

neoorigins:restrict_armor.chest: Item or tag id barred from the chest slot; equipping it ejects the item.
neoorigins:restrict_armor.feet: Item or tag id barred from the feet slot; equipping it ejects the item.
neoorigins:restrict_armor.head: Item or tag id barred from the head slot; equipping it ejects the item.
neoorigins:restrict_armor.legs: Item or tag id barred from the legs slot; equipping it ejects the item.

neoorigins:scare_entities.entity_types: Entity ids or #tags that flee the player within 8 blocks.

neoorigins:shader.shader: Resource location of the post shader to apply (e.g. minecraft:spider).

neoorigins:shadow_orb.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the orb ability can be reused (20 = 1s; default 100).
neoorigins:shadow_orb.max_orbs: Max simultaneous orbs; placing past this removes the oldest (default 4).
neoorigins:shadow_orb.radius: Block radius around each orb given Darkness+Blindness (default 28).
neoorigins:shadow_orb.tick_interval: Ticks between each darkness pulse from orbs (20 = 1s; default 20).

neoorigins:size_scaling.modify_reach: If true, reach scales with body size too (default true). For independent reach use attribute_modifier.

neoorigins:slime_death_save.moisture_threshold: Min slime moisture (0-1) to split instead of dying (default 0.75).
neoorigins:slime_death_save.recovery_ticks: Ticks for reduced max HP to ease back to normal (20 = 1s; default 2400).
neoorigins:slime_death_save.split_max_h_p: Max HP set right after splitting, in half-hearts (default 4.0).
neoorigins:slime_death_save.teleport_distance: Blocks teleported in a random direction on split (default 50).
neoorigins:slime_death_save.teleport_y_range: Max +/- Y offset applied to the split teleport (default 10).

neoorigins:slime_level_hp.levels_per_h_p: Experience levels needed per +1 max HP half-heart (default 10).
neoorigins:slime_level_hp.max_bonus_h_p: Cap on total bonus max HP granted, in half-hearts (default 20).

neoorigins:slime_moisture.armor_penalty_threshold: Moisture (0-1) below which the player loses 4 armor (default 0.10).
neoorigins:slime_moisture.dot_damage: Magic damage dealt per interval when moisture is too low (default 1.0).
neoorigins:slime_moisture.dot_interval: Ticks between drying-out damage ticks (20 = 1s; default 40).
neoorigins:slime_moisture.drain_per_tick: Moisture lost per tick when not in water/rain (default 0.0004).
neoorigins:slime_moisture.fire_drain_multiplier: Drain multiplier while the player is on fire (default 10.0).
neoorigins:slime_moisture.regen_threshold: Moisture (0-1) above which the player gets Regeneration (default 0.75).
neoorigins:slime_moisture.water_refill_per_tick: Moisture regained per tick while in water or rain (default 0.005).

neoorigins:sneaky.detection_multiplier: Mob detection range multiplier; lower = sneakier (default 0.3).

neoorigins:starting_equipment.components: Singular shape: SNBT data-component patch applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.count: Singular shape: stack size of the granted item (default 1).
neoorigins:starting_equipment.enchantments: Singular shape: list of {id, level} enchantments applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.grant_id: Unique id tracked so the bundle is granted only once per player. Dedups the whole power, not individual stacks.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.item: Singular shape: item id granted once after the player commits their origin. Optional when `stacks` is provided.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.legacy_tag: Singular shape: Apoli-style flat SNBT translated into data components on the item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.stacks: Plural shape (v2.1.6): array of stack entries, each with the same per-stack fields as the singular shape (item, count, enchantments, legacy_tag, components). When non-empty, takes precedence over the singular root fields and N items are granted in array order.

neoorigins:stealth.activation_ticks: Ticks of continuous sneaking before invisibility kicks in (200 = 10s).

neoorigins:summon_minion.chest: Item id for the summoned mob's chest slot (optional).
neoorigins:summon_minion.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the summon ability can be reused (200 = 10s).
neoorigins:summon_minion.death_damage: Damage dealt to the player when a minion dies (half-hearts).
neoorigins:summon_minion.despawn_ticks: Ticks a minion lasts before despawning (18000 = 15 min).
neoorigins:summon_minion.feet: Item id for the summoned mob's boots slot (optional).
neoorigins:summon_minion.head: Item id for the summoned mob's helmet slot (defaults to iron helmet).
neoorigins:summon_minion.hunger_cost: Hunger consumed each time a minion is summoned.
neoorigins:summon_minion.legs: Item id for the summoned mob's leggings slot (optional).
neoorigins:summon_minion.mainhand: Item id placed in the summoned mob's main hand (optional).
neoorigins:summon_minion.max_count: Max minions of this type alive at once before summoning is blocked.
neoorigins:summon_minion.mob_type: Entity type id to summon, e.g. minecraft:zombie.
neoorigins:summon_minion.offhand: Item id placed in the summoned mob's off hand (optional).

neoorigins:tame_mob.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the tame ability can be reused (200 = 10s).
neoorigins:tame_mob.death_damage: Damage dealt to the player when a tamed mob dies (half-hearts).
neoorigins:tame_mob.despawn_ticks: Ticks a tamed mob lasts before despawning (36000 = 30 min).
neoorigins:tame_mob.hostile_only: When true (default), only mobs implementing Enemy (zombies, skeletons, creepers, ...) can be tamed. Set false to allow taming any non-player Mob (animals, golems, villagers).
neoorigins:tame_mob.hunger_cost: Hunger consumed each time a mob is tamed.
neoorigins:tame_mob.max_tamed: Max tamed mobs alive at once before taming is blocked.
neoorigins:tame_mob.range: Max distance in blocks to raycast for the mob to tame (default 16).

neoorigins:mount.range: Max distance in blocks to raycast for the entity to mount (default 5).
neoorigins:mount.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the mount ability can be reused (100 = 5s).
neoorigins:mount.hunger_cost: Hunger consumed each time an entity is mounted.
neoorigins:mount.allow_players: Whether this power can mount other players (default true).
neoorigins:mount.allow_mobs: Whether this power can mount mobs (default true).
neoorigins:mount.block_bosses: Prevent mounting boss mobs like the Ender Dragon or Wither (default true).
neoorigins:mount.mount_position: Where the rider sits: 'centered' (on top) or 'shoulder' (offset to one side).

neoorigins:tamed_animal_boost.health_bonus: Flat max-health added to your tamed animals (half-hearts; default 4).
neoorigins:tamed_animal_boost.radius: Block radius around the player scanned for tamed animals (default 32).
neoorigins:tamed_animal_boost.speed_bonus: Flat movement-speed added to your tamed animals (default 0.1).

neoorigins:tamed_potion_diffusal.radius: Block radius for sharing positive potion effects with tamed animals.

neoorigins:thorns_on_hit.damage: Damage reflected to a melee attacker when you are hit (half-hearts; default 2).
neoorigins:thorns_on_hit.fire_ticks: Ticks the attacker is set on fire on reflect (0 = none; 20 = 1s).

neoorigins:tick_action.action_type: Periodic action: teleport_on_damage or none (default none).
neoorigins:tick_action.interval: Ticks between each action run (20 = 1s; default 20).

neoorigins:tidal_wave.cone_angle: Total width in degrees of the forward damage cone (default 60).
neoorigins:tidal_wave.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before the wave can be reused (100 = 5s).
neoorigins:tidal_wave.damage: Damage dealt to each entity in the cone (half-hearts; default 4).
neoorigins:tidal_wave.knockback_strength: Forward push applied to hit entities (default 2).
neoorigins:tidal_wave.range: Max reach of the water cone in blocks (default 8).

neoorigins:toggle.default_value: Initial boolean value before the toggle is first flipped (default false).
neoorigins:toggle.key: Identifier other powers read/flip this named boolean by.

neoorigins:trade_availability.radius: Block radius around the player whose villager trades refresh (default 8).

neoorigins:tree_felling.max_blocks: Maximum connected log blocks broken in one chop (default 64).

neoorigins:twin_breeding.chance: Probability 0.0-1.0 of an extra baby when animals breed (default 1.0).

neoorigins:walk_on_fluid.fluid: Which fluid surface you can walk on: water, lava, or both (default both).

neoorigins:wraith_phase.always_on: If true phasing is always-active instead of a toggle key (default false).
neoorigins:wraith_phase.blocked_blocks: Block ids that cannot be phased through (default obsidian/bedrock).
neoorigins:wraith_phase.exhaustion_per_tick: Food exhaustion added each tick while phasing in solids (default 0.15).
